source_doc.title: Marvell Form 8-K — Google custom semiconductor agreement and warrant
source_doc.permission_basis: Official public SEC filing; retain the canonical URL and only research-relevant excerpts.

sources.quote: Marvell entered into a commercial agreement with Google ... for Marvell’s development of custom semiconductor products for Google
AI inference accelerators for the TPU ecosystem, storage controllers, network interface controllers, memory interface controllers and near-memory compute
a warrant to purchase up to an aggregate of 58,970,907 ordinary shares ... exercise price of $206.58 per share
240 equal tranches, with one tranche vesting for each $500 million of Custom Products Revenue

nodes.name: Google custom semiconductor program with Marvell

claims.statement: Marvell entered a commercial agreement to develop custom semiconductor products for Google spanning TPU inference accelerators, storage controllers, network interface controllers, memory interface controllers and near-memory compute.
claims.disproof_condition: Downgrade if Google or Marvell terminates or materially narrows the program, the custom products fail to enter production, or Google shifts the disclosed scope to another supplier.

claims.statement: Marvell granted Google a warrant for up to 58,970,907 Marvell shares at $206.58; most performance vesting occurs one tranche per $500 million of discretionary Google purchases, so the implied $12.2 billion exercise value is not cash invested today and the implied $120 billion revenue threshold is not a binding purchase commitment.
claims.disproof_condition: Reassess if amended warrant terms create binding minimum purchases, remove discretionary purchase language, materially change the strike or share count, or the agreement is terminated.
